## Service details & FAQs


### Elderly Care at Home in Bathinda

ARDAS Home Health Care provides background-verified elderly caregivers in Bathinda who help ageing parents with daily living, mobility, medication reminders and companionship — so seniors stay safe, dignified and comfortable in their own homes. Caregivers are usually assigned within 24 hours.

Older adults heal, eat and sleep better in familiar surroundings. Yet when children work long hours or live in other cities and abroad, a senior living alone in Bathinda can quickly become unsafe — a missed medicine, a fall in the bathroom, an unnoticed fever. ARDAS elderly care bridges that gap with a trained, verified caregiver inside your home.

Every ARDAS caregiver is identity-checked, background-verified, medically screened and trained before deployment, and our coordinators supervise the care after it starts. Families — including NRI families managing a parent's care from overseas — receive regular updates by phone or WhatsApp.

Included: Help with bathing, grooming, dressing and toileting; Mobility support, walking assistance and fall prevention; Feeding support and meal-time assistance; Medication reminders exactly as advised by the doctor; Daily health tracking — BP, sugar and vitals as advised; Companionship, conversation and activity engagement; Light housekeeping related to the senior's care area; Accompaniment to hospital visits, walks and temple.

Q: How much does elderly care at home cost in Bathinda?
A: The cost depends on the shift (day, night or 24-hour live-in), the level of care your parent needs and the duration of service. ARDAS shares a clear, transparent quote before service begins. Call or WhatsApp +91 98770 62683 for current rates.

Q: Can I choose a male or female caregiver for my parents?
A: Yes. Family preferences for a male or female caregiver are honoured, subject to availability.

Q: Do you provide 24-hour live-in elderly care?
A: Yes. ARDAS provides day-shift, night-shift, 12-hour and 24-hour live-in elderly care in Bathinda, subject to availability.

Q: Will the caregiver also cook and do full housework?
A: Caregivers handle tasks related to the senior's care — meals support, the care area, laundry related to the patient. Full domestic housework or cooking for the whole family is not part of the service.

Q: What if the caregiver is not a good fit for my parents?
A: Tell our coordinator. ARDAS will discuss the issue and arrange a suitable replacement caregiver.

Q: Do you serve areas outside Bathinda city?
A: Yes. Along with all major Bathinda colonies, we coordinate care for nearby towns such as Rampura Phul, Maur Mandi, Talwandi Sabo, Nathana, Sangat, Bhucho Mandi and Goniana, subject to availability.


### Home Nursing Services in Bathinda

ARDAS provides qualified home nurses in Bathinda for clinical care prescribed by your doctor — injections, IV and catheter care, tube feeding, wound dressing, bedsore care and vitals monitoring — delivered safely in the patient's own home.

Hospital-grade clinical care doesn't always need a hospital bed. Whether your loved one is bedridden, recovering from surgery, living with a catheter or feeding tube, or needs regular injections and monitoring, an ARDAS home nurse brings skilled, hygienic, protocol-driven care to your home in Bathinda.

Our nurses work alongside your treating doctor's instructions and keep the family informed at every step. For patients who also need help with bathing, feeding and mobility, a patient attendant can be added alongside the nurse.

Included: Injections (IM, IV, SC) as prescribed by the doctor; IV cannula care and drip management; Urinary catheter care and monitoring; NG tube (Ryle's) feeding and care; Wound dressing and suture/stitch care; Bedsore prevention, dressing and repositioning; Vitals monitoring — BP, pulse, sugar, temperature, SpO2; Colostomy and stoma care; Oxygen and nebulisation assistance as prescribed; Post-stroke and bedridden patient nursing care.

Q: What is the difference between a home nurse and a patient attendant?
A: A home nurse is qualified to perform clinical procedures — injections, catheter and tube care, wound dressing and vitals monitoring — as prescribed by a doctor. A patient attendant helps with non-clinical daily care such as hygiene, feeding, mobility and companionship.

Q: Can a nurse give injections and drips at my home in Bathinda?
A: Yes. ARDAS nurses administer injections, IV fluids and other clinical procedures exactly as prescribed by your treating doctor.

Q: Can I book a nurse for a single visit or only full-time?
A: Both are possible, subject to availability — one-time procedure visits (such as injection or dressing) as well as 12-hour and 24-hour nursing shifts.

Q: How much does a home nurse cost in Bathinda?
A: Nursing charges depend on the shift, the procedures involved and the patient's condition. ARDAS shares a transparent quote before starting. Call or WhatsApp +91 98770 62683 for current rates.

Q: Will the nurse coordinate with our doctor?
A: Yes. Nurses follow your treating doctor's written instructions and report changes in the patient's condition to the family so the doctor can be informed.


### Patient Attendant Services in Bathinda

ARDAS provides trained, background-verified patient attendants in Bathinda who help patients with personal hygiene, feeding, mobility, positioning and everyday care — at home or in hospital — on day, night or 24-hour shifts.

When a family member falls seriously ill, everyday life doesn't stop for the rest of the household. An ARDAS patient attendant takes over the hands-on, non-clinical work of caring — bathing, feeding, toileting, turning, walking support — so the patient is never left alone and the family can breathe.

Attendants are trained in safe patient handling, dignity and hygiene. They are supervised by ARDAS coordinators and can be switched to a qualified home nurse at any time if clinical procedures are needed.

Included: Personal hygiene — bathing, oral care, grooming, dressing; Toileting, diaper changing and incontinence care; Feeding support and meal-time assistance; Turning and repositioning for bedridden patients; Safe mobility and transfer support (bed ↔ wheelchair ↔ commode); Hospital patient sitting during admission; Companionship and emotional support; Observing the patient and informing the family of changes.

Q: What does a patient attendant do that a nurse does not?
A: Attendants focus on non-clinical care — hygiene, feeding, mobility, positioning and companionship. Injections, tube care, dressings and other medical procedures are done by a qualified nurse. ARDAS can provide either or both.

Q: Can I get a patient attendant in hospital in Bathinda?
A: Yes. ARDAS attendants can care for patients during hospital admission in Bathinda, and continue care at home after discharge.

Q: Which shift timings are available?
A: Day shifts, night shifts, 12-hour shifts and 24-hour live-in attendants are available, subject to availability.

Q: Can I get a male attendant for a male patient?
A: Yes. Patient and family preferences for a male or female attendant are honoured, subject to availability.

Q: How much does a patient attendant cost per day in Bathinda?
A: Charges depend on the shift and the level of care needed. ARDAS shares a clear quote before service begins. Call or WhatsApp +91 98770 62683 for current rates.


### Post-Surgical Care at Home in Bathinda

Recovering from surgery is the most delicate phase of treatment. ARDAS provides post-surgical care at home in Bathinda — wound-care assistance, medication reminders, mobility support, nutrition help and daily monitoring — so patients heal safely after hospital discharge.

The first days and weeks after surgery decide how well and how fast a patient recovers. Missed medicines, an infected wound, a fall in the bathroom or poor nutrition can undo the surgeon's good work and send the patient back to hospital.

An ARDAS caregiver bridges the hospital-to-home gap. We follow the discharge instructions, keep the family updated, and coordinate with nurses, physiotherapists and doctors whenever the recovery plan needs them.

Included: Smooth hospital-to-home transition and discharge-instruction support; Surgical wound dressing assistance and incision-care hygiene; Medication reminders on the exact prescribed schedule; Mobility support, walking practice and fall prevention; Personal care — bathing, grooming, toileting — during recovery; Nutrition and hydration support as per the recovery diet; Daily vitals monitoring as advised by the doctor; Coordination for physiotherapy sessions and doctor follow-ups.

Q: When should I book post-surgical home care — before or after the surgery?
A: The best time is before discharge. Share the expected surgery or discharge date and ARDAS will line up a caregiver so that support starts the day the patient reaches home.

Q: How long is post-surgical care usually needed?
A: It depends on the surgery and recovery speed — commonly a few weeks. Service can continue, reduce or stop as the patient recovers; you decide with our coordinator.

Q: Does home care replace hospital nursing?
A: No. ARDAS home care supports recovery at home; any clinical procedure is performed per your treating doctor's instructions, and a qualified nurse can be added when prescribed.

Q: Can I combine a nurse, an attendant and a physiotherapist?
A: Yes. Many recovery plans combine an attendant for daily care, a nurse for procedures and home physiotherapy sessions. ARDAS coordinates all of them together.

Q: What does post-surgical care at home cost in Bathinda?
A: Cost depends on the care mix (attendant/nurse/physio), shift and duration. ARDAS gives a transparent quote before starting. Call or WhatsApp +91 98770 62683.


### Physiotherapy at Home in Bathinda

ARDAS brings physiotherapy to your home in Bathinda. Our home-visit physiotherapists help patients recover after surgery, rebuild movement after stroke or paralysis, and manage back, knee and joint pain — without the struggle of travelling to a clinic.

For someone recovering from a stroke or a knee replacement, every trip to a clinic is painful, exhausting — sometimes impossible. Home physiotherapy removes that barrier: the therapist comes to you, works in your real living environment, and trains the family on exercises between sessions.

Each visit follows a structured plan — assessment, hands-on therapy, guided exercises and measurable progress goals — coordinated with the patient's doctor and, if needed, with an ARDAS caregiver for daily support.

Included: Post-operative rehabilitation (knee/hip replacement, spine, abdominal surgery); Stroke, paralysis and hemiplegia rehabilitation; Elderly mobility, balance and fall-prevention training; Back, neck, knee and shoulder pain management; Strengthening, stretching and range-of-motion exercises; Gait (walking) training and assisted mobilisation; A written home-exercise plan the family can continue between visits; Progress reviews shared with the patient's doctor on request.

Q: How long is each physiotherapy session, and how many will I need?
A: Sessions typically last 30–45 minutes. The number of sessions depends on the condition and recovery goals — the physiotherapist shares a plan after the first assessment.

Q: Does the physiotherapist bring equipment?
A: Therapists carry the essential items needed for the session and also use what is safely available at home. Any additional equipment is suggested to the family in advance.

Q: How soon after surgery can physiotherapy start at home?
A: Usually within days of the surgeon's clearance. Always follow your operating doctor's advice; ARDAS can start home sessions as soon as the doctor permits.

Q: What is the charge for physiotherapy at home in Bathinda?
A: Charges depend on the condition, session length and number of visits. Call or WhatsApp +91 98770 62683 for current per-session and package rates.

Q: Can physiotherapy be combined with a caregiver or nurse?
A: Yes. Many families combine physiotherapy sessions with an ARDAS attendant or nurse for daily care between sessions.


### Babysitter Services at Home in Bathinda

ARDAS provides trained, background-verified babysitters in Bathinda for newborns, infants and toddlers — attentive feeding, hygiene, safe play and sleep-time care in your own home, on part-time, full-time or night schedules.

Leaving a baby with anyone is hard. Every ARDAS babysitter is identity-checked and background-verified before deployment, trained in infant care basics — safe feeding, hygiene, sleep safety and gentle engagement — and supervised by our coordinators.

Whether you are a working couple, a mother recovering after delivery, or a family hosting guests or attending an event, a verified babysitter keeps your child safe, fed and comforted at home.

Included: Newborn and infant feeding support as directed by the mother; Diapering, bathing support and baby hygiene; Safe, supervised play and age-appropriate engagement; Nap and sleep-time care and monitoring; Bottle sterilisation and keeping the baby's area clean; Support for the mother — bringing the baby for feeds, night help; Immediate contact with parents in case of any concern.

Q: What ages of children do your babysitters care for?
A: Newborns, infants and toddlers — from the first weeks of life up to young children, as agreed with the family.

Q: How are ARDAS babysitters verified?
A: Every babysitter undergoes identity and background verification, a medical fitness check and child-care training, with ongoing supervision by ARDAS coordinators.

Q: Can I book a babysitter for just a few hours?
A: Yes — hourly/part-time, full-day, evening and overnight bookings are possible, subject to availability.

Q: Will the babysitter cook and do household work?
A: Babysitters handle the child's needs — feeding, hygiene and the child's area. Household cooking and cleaning for the family are not part of the service.

Q: What does a babysitter cost in Bathinda?
A: Charges depend on hours, schedule and the child's needs. ARDAS shares a transparent quote before booking. Call or WhatsApp +91 98770 62683.


### Lab Test Facility at Home in Bathinda

Skip the queue at the lab. ARDAS arranges lab test sample collection at your home in Bathinda — a trained phlebotomist visits your doorstep, collects the sample safely, and digital reports are shared with you on time.

For a senior who walks with difficulty, a patient on bed rest, or a parent who needs regular monitoring tests, travelling to a laboratory is the hardest part of a simple blood test. ARDAS reverses it: the lab comes home.

Samples are collected by trained phlebotomists using sterile, single-use equipment and transported to partner laboratories under proper handling conditions. Reports are shared digitally — on WhatsApp or email — according to the test's reporting timeline.

Included: Home blood sample collection by a trained phlebotomist; Sterile, single-use collection equipment; Safe sample handling and transport to the partner laboratory; Tests as advised by your doctor, subject to availability; Digital reports on WhatsApp or email as per the test timeline; Convenient appointment slots — including early morning fasting tests; Repeat-collection support for regular monitoring patients.

Q: How do I book a lab test at home in Bathinda?
A: Call or WhatsApp +91 98770 62683 with your test list or doctor's prescription. We confirm the slot, and a phlebotomist collects the sample at your home.

Q: When will I get my reports?
A: Reports are shared digitally according to the test and the partner laboratory's reporting timeline — many routine tests the same day. The expected time is confirmed at booking.

Q: Do I need to fast before the test?
A: Some tests (like blood sugar fasting or lipid profile) need fasting. We tell you the requirements for your specific tests when you book.

Q: Which areas do you cover for home sample collection?
A: All major colonies of Bathinda city and nearby towns, subject to slot availability. Call to confirm your location.

Q: What does a home lab test cost?
A: Test charges depend on the tests and the partner laboratory. ARDAS confirms the exact amount before the visit. Call +91 98770 62683 for test-wise rates.
